objects.description: [IronNetInjector](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0581) can identify processes via C# methods such as GetProcessesByName and running [Tasklist](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0057) with the Python os.popen function.(Citation: Unit 42 IronNetInjector February 2021 )
